capabilities: generate Steam Guard codes from a shared secret in an inline code block
reveal codes on hover or keep them always visible
generate codes locally without sending secrets or codes off the device
disambiguation: It only displays two-factor codes; it does not log you into Steam or manage your accounts.
extras: The README warns that Steam Guard via the official mobile app is the only Valve-endorsed two-factor method, that other plugins could read the stored secret from the vault, and that users must know how to obtain their account's shared secret via an external guide.
intentEvidence: The original steam-totp implementation has been patched with minimal changes
motivation: The author built it for convenience when managing multiple Steam accounts, especially for bot developers handling automated trading across dozens of accounts.
problem: Checking Steam Guard codes means opening the official mobile app each time, which is slow when switching between many Steam accounts.

relations.evidence: The original steam-totp implementation has been patched with minimal changes

summary: Generates live Steam Guard two-factor codes inside inline code blocks in notes, using a Steam shared secret.
